impact: A tech-led rebound would help NBIS, MU, DRAM and BE recover part of Tuesday's losses heading into Nebius's Thursday report, though rate-hike pricing keeps a lid on long-duration growth names.
summary: US Nasdaq futures rose about 1.5% and S&P 500 futures 0.6% early Wednesday, with tech lifted by CoreWeave's earnings beat after Tuesday's Nvidia- and CPI-driven losses. In Europe the Euro Stoxx and DAX opened up about 0.9% and the CAC 40 0.6%, with the DAX near its record around 26,692 and lower oil prices helping. One report put December Fed hike odds at about 82%.
title: Nasdaq futures up 1.5% on CoreWeave beat; Europe opens up 0.9%
